/** @param {number} count @returns {number} */
export function threshold(count) { return count * 0.9; }

import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
export function run() { return spawnSync('echo', ['hello']); }
export function session(options) { return options?.session ?? null; }
export function record() { return { status: "executed", exitCode: 0 }; }
export function selected(values) { return values.filter(value => value > 0).join(","); }
export function parse(value) { try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch { return null; } }
export async function execute(run) { return await run(); }
